PAGE TITLE: OTHER INFORMATION / AGENCY RESPONSE TO OIG REPORT ON NASA'S TOP MANAGEMENT AND PERFORMANCE CHALLENGES

KEY FACTS:
- Blue Origin’s focus on collaboration and transparency with NASA helps refine expectations and structures of firm-fixed-price agreements.
- NASA remains committed to ensuring safe missions to the Moon, reflecting dedication to the safety of astronauts, mission success, and the advancement of human space exploration.
- Challenge 3: Enabling Mission Critical Capabilities and Support Services.
- The Agency’s Office of the Chief Human Capital Officer modernized the recruiting process and developed a coordinated recruitment strategy using a standardized approach leveraging digital platforms to engage with prospective candidates.
- NASA has received multiple awards in 2022, 2023, and 2024 in recognition of outreach and employment of under-represented groups.
- The NASA 2040 initiative, launched in June 2023, brings a new focus in aligning institutional operations to priority mission needs.
- Awards included: America’s Best Employers for Diversity (Forbes, 2023, 2022), America’s Best Employers for New Graduates (Forbes, 2024, 2023, 2022), America’s Best Employer for Veterans (Forbes, 2023, 2022), America’s Best Employers for Women (Forbes, 2024, 2023, 2022).
- Additional awards included: Ranked #1 Most Prestigious Internships (Vault/Firsthand, 2023), Top 20 Government Employers (STEM Workforce Diversity Magazine, 2023), and Top 20 Government Employers (Woman Engineer Magazine, 2023).
